PRIVACY POLICY

PriorityDesk privacy policy

Last updated: 11 October 2026.

PriorityDesk is made by Taynium. Contact: prioritydesk@outlook.com.

What the app stores.

Your tasks, projects, notes, reminders and the files and photos you attach are stored on your phone. If you sign in with a Microsoft account, they are also copied to the app's own folder in your OneDrive (Apps\PriorityDesk) so your other devices can sync them.

What we receive.

Nothing. The developer runs no servers and receives none of your data. There are no ads, analytics or tracking.

Microsoft sign-in.

Sign-in is handled by Microsoft. The app asks only for access to its own OneDrive folder, and uses your account name only to show who is signed in. Microsoft's privacy statement applies to your account.

Permissions.

Notifications and alarms are used only for your reminders. The camera, photos and files are used only when you choose to attach something.

Deleting your data.

Delete tasks in the app, or uninstall it to remove everything from the phone. Remove the Apps\PriorityDesk folder in OneDrive to delete the synced copy.
